statistical_protocol.unit: adaptation seed; corruptions averaged within seed first
statistical_protocol.pairing: same dataset/domain/seed; GPU topology is provenance, not a matching key
statistical_protocol.source: one fixed A; no repeated independent source measurements
statistical_protocol.uncertainty: conditional on fixed source; adaptation randomness only
statistical_protocol.warning: low power; exact two-sided sign-flip minimum p is 0.25
statistical_protocol.ci: 95% percentile bootstrap, 100000 seed-block resamples, RNG seed42; fragile at n=3
statistical_protocol.t_test: two-sided one-sample t on seed-level paired deltas; assumes normal differences
statistical_protocol.holm: manifest-declared methods per dataset/role/metric/comparison_group; no adjustment until the entire declared family is complete
statistical_protocol.rPC: 100 * seed mPC / fixed A clean TEST
statistical_protocol.method_clean_normalized: separate: 100 * seed mPC / same-method same-seed clean
statistical_protocol.recovery: (method - A_corruption) / (A_clean_TEST - A_corruption); undefined for nonpositive gap; descriptive only, unstable near zero; no clipping or ranking
